name: Deposited wind-blown organics
description: Organic matter deposited with wind-blown sediment beneath the hummocks - the belowground energy base. Its isotope signature is markedly 13C-depleted compared with the fog grass, and the soil nematodes run on it rather than on the plant above: the study's key evidence that the FPO is two coupled, isotopically distinct food webs. Functional group matching the deposited-sources pool identified by the source's belowground isotope data.
